focus: Regime detection / macro-conditional strategies (primary); factor timing; production portfolio upgrades

papers_reviewed.title: Continuous Timing Signals for Growth-Defensive Style Allocation: Factor Attribution, Risk Matching, and Out-of-Sample Evidence
papers_reviewed.relevance: HIGH — direct design template for H249/H250. Continuous smooth-score (rate relief + SPY drawdown + VIX stress + crowding penalty → tanh) applied to growth/defensive ETF basket. Sharpe 1.01, CAGR 19.24%, MaxDD -31.63% (2017-2026, 10bp costs). Replaces discrete regime bins with smooth weight transitions. Selected as H250 proposal.

papers_reviewed.title: Regime-Based Portfolio Allocation Using Hidden Markov Models and Reinforcement Learning
papers_reviewed.relevance: HIGH — 3-state HMM (low-vol/transitional/high-vol) on SPY/TLT/GLD daily data (2004-2025). RL-enhanced HMM outperforms rule-based rotation; SPY dominates in stable regimes, TLT/GLD provide protection in stressed periods. Uses hmmlearn (already in our pipeline). Selected as H251 proposal.

papers_reviewed.title: Geometric Observables for Financial Regime Detection
papers_reviewed.relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH — Berry Phase Rate from spectral embedding of equity-index returns. 67% fewer false alarms than supervised RF; largely uncorrelated with classical signals (|rho| ≈ 0.22). Code available at GitHub. Novel early-warning layer distinct from VIX+SMA. Selected as H252 proposal (HIGH risk due to implementation complexity).

papers_reviewed.title: Dynamic allocation: extremes, tail dependence, and regime Shifts
papers_reviewed.relevance: MEDIUM — GARCH-DCC-Copula regime model for global factor performance prediction. 68 pages. Relevant but too complex to implement as a standalone hypothesis. Better as reference for factor timing context. Not selected for proposal.
papers_reviewed.reason_rejected: Implementation complexity (GARCH-DCC-Copula) too high; 68-page paper without code; arXiv:2410.14841 (Shu & Mulvey 2024, SJM factor timing) already covers this angle better.

papers_reviewed.title: FactorEngine: Knowledge-Infused Factor Mining
papers_reviewed.relevance: LOW — LLM-based alpha factor mining for Chinese market. Not directly applicable to our US equity pipeline. No confirmed factors.
papers_reviewed.reason_rejected: China market focus; LLM factor mining approach similar to already-staged QuantaAlpha (H236).

wiki_expansion.rationale: Backtesting section was thinnest at 5 pages; regime signals are immediately needed for H249/H250 implementation; companion to existing algorithms/regime-detection.md (methods) and backtesting/design-principles.md (framework). Covers SPY 200MA, VIX (FRED VIXCLS), yield curve (T10Y2Y, DGS10), continuous score construction, look-ahead discipline, and complete production code.

strategic_context: Tonight's H249 design (regime-conditional production weights) establishes the first macro-regime overlay on the full production portfolio. H250 (continuous score) is the direct upgrade — smoother transitions should reduce unnecessary rebalancing. H251 is a complementary standalone tactical allocation that could eventually be blended into the production mix. H252 is the speculative long-shot: a leading indicator could give us 1-2 week advance warning of regime changes, enabling proactive rather than reactive weight adjustments.
next_frontier: H250 → H251 → H252 (in priority order). If H250 confirms: apply continuous regime score to live paper trading alongside H249. If H251 confirms: evaluate as 10-15% satellite allocation within production portfolio (currently all momentum-based rotation).
